patch_description: This implementation introduces a sparse CRZ-based ansatz with parameter sharing across qubit pairs. The key improvements are: 1) Using CRZ gates on non-overlapping qubit pairs to maintain sparsity while ensuring full qubit connectivity, 2) Sharing parameters within each qubit pair to reduce the total parameter count, 3) Adding a final RZ layer for better expressivity without increasing depth significantly. This approach balances expressivity with parameter efficiency, aiming to reduce overfitting while maintaining high accuracy.
